items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: Joe Turner, he lives in New Orleans too. He was overseas with us.

ctx.x: I used to play a harmonica a great bit before my tonsils got too bad. Couldn't play it now. And I've been thinking about just going, give me a rack, and put my music in with a harmonica to save me a singing, you know. Every once in a while I sing. So that's what I'm figuring on down. I had a harmonica when I was over in Los Angeles. No, not there I was. Yeah. I was in Los Angeles. I believe it was. See, now I don't want to get it. I was. But Junior Welch, he wanted it, and I let him have it. Yes. Joe Turner, he…
I never see him down there. I see him in New York once in a while, but I never see him in New Orleans.
